description:
VetPulse: US veterans benefits intelligence API. AI-synthesized guidance on VA disability compensation, Aid & Attendance pension, TDIU, claim strategy, caregiver stipends, GI Bill, state benefits, VA healthcare

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • disability ($0.15): Veteran disability rating analysis (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • aid-attendance ($0.15): Veteran pension / Aid & Attendance-style eligibility (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • tdiu ($0.15): TDIU / unemployability eligibility (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • claim-builder ($0.20): Veteran disability claim evidence strategy (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • caregiver ($0.10): Veteran family caregiver stipend and benefits (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • education ($0.10): Veteran education benefit comparison (US GI Bill; UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany equivalents)
  • state-benefits ($0.10): State/regional veteran benefits (US states; UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany regions)
  • home-loan ($0.08): Veteran home-buying assistance analysis (US VA loan; Australia DHOAS; UK Forces Help to Buy)
  • discounts ($0.05): Verified veteran discounts by category (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)
  • healthcare ($0.08): Veteran healthcare priority/coverage analysis (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Germany)

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: disability | aid-attendance | tdiu | claim-builder | caregiver | education | state-benefits | home-loan | discounts | healthcare

assets.description: Total net worth in USD excluding primary home and one vehicle

branch.description: Military branch — affects reserve component benefit calculations

care_cost.description: Monthly unreimbursed care costs in USD — deducted from income for pension calculation

chapter.description: GI Bill chapter of interest (e.g. '33', '30', '35', '1606') — or omit for full comparison

country.description: Country whose veteran disability system to assess: US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, or Germany (other countries supported on a best-effort basis). Defaults to US if omitted and cannot be inferred.

current_rating.description: Current combined rating if filing a supplemental or new claim

dependents.description: Whether veteran has dependents — affects DEA transferability and some benefit calculations

disability_rating.description: VA disability rating percentage — many state benefits require minimum rating (e.g. '70', '100', 'P&T')

income.description: Monthly gross income in USD (Social Security, pension, other)

needs.description: Care needs description (e.g. 'requires daily assistance with bathing, dressing, and medication management')

previous_denials.description: Description of any previous claim denials — affects strategy (HLR vs. Board appeal vs. supplemental)

prior_va_loan.description: Whether veteran has used a VA loan before — triggers entitlement restoration guidance

priority_group.description: Current VA priority group if known (1–8)

purchase_price.description: Target home purchase price in USD — used to calculate funding fee savings and PMI comparison

school_location.description: School city and state — used to estimate monthly housing allowance (E-5 with dependent BAH rate)

service_era.description: Service era for presumptive condition assessment (e.g. 'Vietnam', 'Gulf War', 'OEF', 'OIF', 'Korea')

state.description: US state/region (helps infer country if omitted)

surviving_spouse.description: Set true if applicant is a surviving spouse of a veteran — unlocks Survivors Pension and different Aid & Attendance rates

work_history.description: Work history and current work status (e.g. 'cannot maintain substantially gainful employment due to PTSD and chronic pain')

name: vetpulse
